subject: Warm intro from AWS: Strata AI — joint customer runbook
messages:
From: AWS Partner SA <aws-sa@amazon.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro: Strata AI + Redwood — warm handoff

Hi Sean,

Quick intro — Strata AI is evaluating options to standardize inference for their data platform and AWS recommended we connect. Amy Chen (cc'd) is the Head of Platform at Strata. They want a solution that gives predictable latency for customer-facing features and an easy path to dedicated capacity.

Amy — meet Sean Gallagher who leads cloud partnerships at Redwood Inference. Sean and team have experience running mixed dedicated/hosted deployments and joint procurement plays with AWS.

If possible can we set up a 30–45 minute discovery next week for a technical + commercial sync? AWS and Redwood can join to map success metrics.

Thanks,
David (AWS Partner SA)
AWS Partner Network

---
(attachment: Strata_initial_onepager.pdf)

From: sean_gallagher@redwood.com
To: amy.chen@strata.ai, j.marks@strata.ai
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-28T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Strata AI + Redwood — warm handoff

Hi Amy / Jordan — great to meet you both (virtually). Thanks David for the intro.

High level: Redwood runs a unified inference runtime that many customers put behind product features; common asks are latency SLAs, predictable monthly run rates, and simplified procurement for Dedicated pools. Our goal on a first call is to understand Strata's target SLAs, peak qps, and any compliance constraints.

Proposed agenda (30m):
- 5 min intros and objectives
- 10 min current architecture & pain points (Amy/Jordan)
- 10 min how Redwood handles tight-latency workloads + reference case
- 5 min next steps / mutual action items

Vanessa / Karthik — I cc'd you for pricing/ops and partner motion support. Vanessa, can you pull a draft runbook and rough ballpark for a staged Dedicated pilot? Karthik, can you suggest an AWS-facing enablement slide for the call?

Amy — a couple of availability slots I have next week: Tue 10/3 11:30–12p PT, Wed 10/4 9–9:45a PT, Fri 10/6 2–2:45p PT. If those don't work, happy to punch in a calendar poll.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Head, Cloud Partnerships
Redwood Inference
(attachment: Redwood_quick-reference.pdf)

From: Amy Chen <amy.chen@strata.ai>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Cc: j.marks@strata.ai, aws-sa@amazon.com
Date: 2026-10-29T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Strata AI + Redwood — warm handoff

Hi Sean — thanks for the clear agenda. Fri 10/6 2–2:45p PT works for Jordan and me.

A few quick data points to help you prep:
- Prod traffic: 12M inference requests/month, 95th latency target ~120ms across US regions
- Peak spikes: 4k rps sustained for short windows during nightly batch+ingest
- Compliance: SOC2 required, some PII transit (no storage)

Can you share a short one-pager on pilot scope and ops responsibilities ahead of the call? We also prefer a short mutual action plan so procurement has visibility.

Amy Chen
Head of Platform, Strata AI
(attachment: Strata_platform_overview.docx)

From: sean_gallagher@redwood.com
To: amy.chen@strata.ai, j.marks@strata.ai
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, camila_reyes@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-30T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Strata pilot runbook + MAP (attached) — prepping Fri 10/6 call

Amy / Jordan — attached is a short draft runbook and a two-sheet Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that lays out responsibilities, timeline, and expected success metrics. High level pilot proposal: 6-week scoped pilot with a small Dedicated pool in us-west-2, prefix caching for heavy tail, and a test harness to exercise 1k rps sustained to validate latency.

Who does what (quick):
- Strata: provide representative prompt set + acceptance SLA test harness
- Redwood: provision Dedicated pool, initial model variant selection, runbook + rollback plan
- AWS: support networking and account enablement (David is on the thread)

Attachments: Strata_Redwood_Joint_Runbook_v0.3.pdf, MutualActionPlan_Strata.xlsx

Agenda for Fri 10/6 2p PT (30m):
1) Intros + success criteria (5m)
2) Walk the runbook + roles (10m)
3) Pilot timeline & milestones (10m)
4) Immediate next steps & procurement ask (5m)

Camila — can you spin up a short slide (1–2) with the kickoff timeline and share the Calendly/meeting link? Vanessa — please add a rough pricing band and a note about reserved capacity options. Karthik — I'll ask you to own the AWS enablement checklist.

Thanks — see you Friday.

—
Sean Gallagher
Head, Cloud Partnerships
Redwood Inference
(attachment: Strata_Redwood_Joint_Runbook_v0.3.pdf)
(attachment: MutualActionPlan_Strata.xlsx)

From: Jordan Marks <j.marks@strata.ai>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.com, amy.chen@strata.ai
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, camila_reyes@redwood.com, aws-sa@amazon.com
Date: 2026-11-02T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Strata pilot runbook + MAP (attached) — prepping Fri 10/6 call

Thanks all — confirmed for the meeting. We reviewed the runbook and MAP internally; a couple of quick asks:
- Can the pilot include an initial smoke test with our anonymized dataset ahead of provisioning?
- We'd like a section in the runbook that spells out data flow and KMS usage (Amy will own this).

Sean / Vanessa — if you can add the smoke-test step and a KMS appendix to the runbook, we can route this through procurement next week. Looking forward to a productive kickoff.

Cheers,
Jordan
VP Product, Strata AI
(google-meeting: https://meet.google.com/xyz-abc-123)
